## tmh members list

List all members

### Synopsis

Returns a list of the organization's members, its admins and learners. Pass `role=admin` to list only admins.

--all follows every page, keeping the other flags, and prints all the items as one JSON array, so `| jq` works; add --ndjson to print one compact item per line as each page arrives.

Scopes: members:read

```
tmh members list [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --all                         follow every page and print all the items as one JSON array; --limit sets the page size
      --cursor nextCursor           The nextCursor from the previous page.
  -h, --help                        help for list
      --include enrollmentSubject   Opt-in, comma-separated. With enrollmentSubject, a member whose `subjectId` is null carries `enrollmentSubjectId`: the subject their email resolves to (a never-signed-in invitee), or null when none. Use it only to match the member to Enrollments; it is not an address for member routes. With `holdsInvitation`, each learner carries `holdsInvitation`: whether the organization has an invitation for their email or a Seat bound to them. Each key is omitted when its lookup failed.
      --limit int                   How many objects to return, between 1 and 1000. Defaults to 20.
      --ndjson                      with --all, print one compact JSON item per line as each page arrives
      --role string                 Only admins (paginated); one of: admin
```
